All of our intelligence layouts on the Cloud Knights had been exposed, and many men were lost. Now it can be determined that there is more than one dog among us, and most of them are still hiding on the Luofu.

Find out the identity of those hounds as soon as possible and get rid of them. Be careful not to leave any traces. Based on past experience, no matter what means are used, it is difficult to get any information from the hounds, which makes them of no use to us.

Suppressing her disdain for bustling crowds, Seele scans across the faces in the Plaza with her careful gaze. Her hard work pays off, and she soon locks onto a target. A man wearing a gray hat, his hands in his pockets, is scuttling back and forth through the crowds while slyly looking from side to side with a sharp expression. After confirming that nobody is watching — at least, so he thinks — the man reaches out to grab the satchel of the woman beside him. But before his fingers could reach the bag's zip, a slender but forceful hand quickly grabs his wrist. He nearly cries out with the pain, but Seele clasps her other hand over his mouth. "Not a peep from you." The majestic cry of horns resounds throughout the skies, and the bustling crowd falls silent immediately. A man in a comical outfit rushes to the podium, and shouts in a piercing voice — "Ladies and gentlemen! For the ribbon-cutting part of this ceremony, please welcome to the stage — the Supreme Guardian herself, Madam Bronya Rand!" Deafening cheers erupt from the plaza. Seele quietly pulls the pickpocket out of the crowd during the ruckus, and escorts him to the Silvermane Guards on duty. She turns to look back at the distant stage, and briefly locks eyes with the woman in the white dress. The Supreme Guardian flashes her an ever-so-brief smile, and Seele nods slightly in response. And then, they go their separate ways — one stepping into the light, the other into the shadows. — One day, they will finally meet again.

Supplicants Run Amok, Ceremony Stained with Blood: What Lies Ahead for the Phantasmoon Games? On July 22, Year 1984 of the Arcadian Calendar, a Supplicant entered Graphia Academy. Using the school as a starting point, the perpetrator murdered 22 students preparing for the anniversary celebration before advancing toward the Dovebrook District. The rampage resulted in a total of 146 casualties among innocent citizens, with hundreds more caught in the crossfire, with most suffering secondary trauma directly or indirectly. The victims have been rushed to various major hospitals across Duomension City for emergency treatment. Note: The terror of the populace has provided a massive surge of Wishpower to the Supplicant known as the "Herald of Death." This immense Path energy is now concentrated within a Pathstrider blessed by a mask of Elation... ... The Department of Aberration Defense has issued a statement confirming the successful suppression of out-of-control Supplicant. Several Supplicants died during the operation to take down the Herald of Death, and this round of Phantasmoon Games may be forced to shut down. Note: The IPC's records are frustratingly vague about the Herald of Death's abilities and how it was taken down. Reason unknown. Revelry Under the Shadow of Fear Recently, the program Please Be Happy, launched by Seafeld TV, has caused a massive stir throughout Planarcadia. Some viewers claim that seeing victims move beyond their pasts and face the future is proof that Planarcadia is finally stepping out from the shadow of the Bloodstained Games and toward a new beginning. However, others argue that this practice, akin to tearing open the wounds of the Herald of Death survivors for public consumption, is a symptom of a growing sickness within Planarcadia. These critics suggest the public doesn't truly care if the victims find happiness. Rather, they are simply using those smiles as a tool to conquer their own deep-seated fears. Note: Seafeld TV has since been restructured into Fulwish TV. An Execution Long Overdue On July 22, Year 1994 of the Arcadian Calendar, the Department of Aberration Defense announced that the death sentence for the Herald of Death was carried out today. However, this decade-late execution has done little to quell public resentment toward the Interastral Peace Corporation. Protests of varying scales have broken out across Duomension City, Seafeld City, and several other regions. The IPC Resident Overseer has yet to issue a response regarding the unrest. ... Ten years have passed since the Herald of Death incident, and Planarcadia has entered a period of peace and tranquility rarely seen in a century. Even so, the terror and unease brought by the Herald of Death still linger like a dark, oppressive shadow over people's hearts. Survivors, burdened by the pain of their survival, took their own lives, and the orphans of the Bloodstained Games became scars etched into Planarcadia. People are terrified of a Supplicant who could claim their lives in an instant, but they also fear the Interastral Peace Corporation that views everything as mere numbers and assets. Note: The ambiguity with which the IPC managed the aftermath of the Herald of Death incident may be evidence of a deeper entanglement to the incident than previously disclosed.
